command: for f in /run/glove/llm-ca/ca.pem; do i=0; until grep -qF 'BEGIN CERTIFICATE' "$f" 2>/dev/null || [ $i -ge 30 ]; do i=$((i+1)); sleep 1; done; done; for f in /run/glove/llm-ca/ca.pem; do grep -qF 'BEGIN CERTIFICATE' "$f" 2>/dev/null || { echo "glove: the trusted CA $f is missing" >&2; exit 90; }; done; grep -qF 'BEGIN CERTIFICATE' /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt || { echo "glove: no CA roots at /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt" >&2; exit 90; }; for f in /run/glove/llm-ca/ca.pem; do cat "$f"; echo; done > /etc/glove/ca/extra.pem && cat /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/glove/ca/extra.pem > /etc/glove/ca/bundle.pem || exit 90; exec "$@"
